evidence.supportingExcerpt: Two fictional six-symbol PD-1-positive populations near cancer have different controlled peptide responses: one viral and one tumour-peptide directed. Preserve tissue, sampling time, population definitions and controlled function alongside RNA/protein panels; favourable markers or division alone cannot predict benefit.
